opportunities.Title: FKK Winter College ID Camp for Girls — December 2026
opportunities.Cost: Organizer lists $225 per player. Confirm current fees and remaining places.
opportunities.Short Description: December 12 college ID camp at FreeKick Orlando for high-school girls born 2007–2011, including non-FKK players.
opportunities.Full Description:
Florida Kraze Krush lists its Winter College ID Camp for Girls on Saturday, December 12, 2026 at FreeKick Orlando, 3180 Southgate Commerce Blvd, Orlando, FL 32806. Its page invites high-school girls born 2007–2011, including players outside FKK, and lists $225 per player. College coaches lead rotating training sessions and games.

The organizer lists 8:30 AM check-in and a 3:30 PM finish. It provides a PlayMetrics registration link and says spaces are limited. A PlayMetrics account is required; account creation being free does not make the camp free. Confirm remaining space, eligibility, current cost and schedule with FKK. Coach attendance and recruitment outcomes are not guaranteed.
opportunities.Review Note: Official page checked October 19: explicit dated event, birth-year eligibility, $225 fee, venue and registration action. No registration deadline established. Check current space directly; no scholarship or selection promise.

opportunities.Title: FKK Spring 2027 Recreational Soccer — Registration Waitlist
opportunities.Cost: Spring 2027 fees must be confirmed with FKK. The visible $275/$300 prices are labeled Fall 2026 and are not used as spring prices.
opportunities.Short Description: Join FKK’s Spring 2027 registration waitlist for U9–U19 recreational soccer. Placement is not yet confirmed.
opportunities.Full Description:
FKK’s official recreational page says Fall 2026 is closed/full and Spring registration is open. Spring applicants are initially waitlisted and must wait for a release notification before completing registration. This is a registration-interest pathway, not a confirmed place on a team.

The club describes U9–U19 recreational programs and publishes birth-date ranges. Younger in-house and older travel formats differ; confirm the player’s exact group, Spring 2027 field, training dates and fees with FKK. The fall schedule and fall prices shown on the same page are not presented as spring terms. The club’s Winter Springs contact location is not a guarantee of the assigned playing venue.
opportunities.Review Note: Official page explicitly labels Fall 2026 CLOSED/FULL and Spring 2027 registration OPEN but initially waitlisted. Title and summary preserve the waitlist condition. Spring dates/fees/placement require confirmation; do not reuse fall terms.

opportunities.Title: Florida Premier REC+ — Recreational Soccer
opportunities.Cost: Page lists $189 early pricing and $209 standard season pricing. Confirm current season, park, kit and registration terms.
opportunities.Short Description: Recreational skill sessions and matches at neighborhood parks across Tampa Bay and Ocala. Choose your actual park before enrolling.
opportunities.Full Description:
Florida Premier’s REC+ page describes recreational soccer for boys and girls U7–U19, with skill work and matches at neighborhood parks. It links to registration and a dedicated program site. Listed areas include Wesley Chapel, Trinity, Land O’ Lakes, Zephyrhills, Temple Terrace and Ocala. Tampa is the regional search location, not the venue of every session.

The source lists $189 early pricing and $209 regular pricing, and age divisions with birth-year groupings. Confirm the exact current season, park, age-group cutoff, price and available spaces on the official program page before enrolling. No single schedule or capacity is promised for all six locations.
opportunities.Review Note: Official REC+ program page checked October 19: program description, U7–U19 audience, six areas, prices and registration action. Choose a specific park and confirm current schedule/capacity. Do not equate regional Tampa search label with exact venue.
